tei:div.tei:p: sog dbon rin chen bzang po'i lo rgyus/

༄༅/ /de rnams las bka' brgyud gser gyi phreng ba'i gral la bzhugs pa ni sog dbon rin chen bzang po ste/ sog zam khar 'brong bu go'i shri chen po'i gdung rigs su 'khrungs/ dpal ldan gsang phur sde snod thams cad byang bar mdzad de thog mar bka' bzhi'i grwa skor mdzad pas bka' bzhi par grags/ mdo sngags kyi gzhung lugs mtha' dag la 'chad rtsod rtsom pa la zla med pas mtshan rig pa'i ral grir gsol/ rje yi byin rlabs mtha' dag zhugs te spang rtogs kyi yon tan thams cad rdzogs nas rje don ldan zhabs kyi yongs 'dzin mdzad cing*/ bstod pa thang sku mdzad phyir kha byang brgya rtsa brgyad pa gcig mdzad pa rje dpa' bos dpe ma rnyed cing*/ rnyed na bkod par bya gsungs pa de 'dir bkod par bya ste/ bla ma rin po che'i rnam thar re'u mig tu bkod pa ni/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug shes rab rdo rje zhes bya bar gyur pa/ 1 ras chung rdo rje grags pa zhes bya bar gyur pa/ 2 rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug ratna rasmir gyur pa/ 3 snyan brgyud gdams pa'i gter 'dzin saṃ ga lakṣar gyur pa/ 4 mkhas pa chen po rin chen ye shes su gyur pa/ 5 mtha' bral chos kyi dbyings su mnyam par bzhugs pa/ 6 mngon byang lnga'i man ngag rtsal sbyangs te gzugs skur snang ba/ 7 gzhon nus spyod pas ma bcos pa'i shes pa gtan la phab pa/ 8 bshes gnyen puṣye puṣti las dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa thob pa/ 9 mkhan po sangs rgyas rin chen gyi drung du dge tshul gyi sdom pa thob pa/ 10 chos rje rol pa'i rdo rje dang mjal nas lung bstan zhing gdams pa gnang ba/ 11 gsang phur mtshan nyid kyi chos rnams gsan zhing mkhas par sbyangs pa/ 12 slob dpon ratna shrī la sgrol ma tshe dpag med dang dus 'khor gyi bskyed rdzogs gsan pa/ 13 dkon mchog tshul khrims/ pad ma sngon po/ gzhon nu blo ldan rnams la chos gsan pa/ 14 bka' bzhi pa seng ge rgyal mtshan/

blo gsal ba rnams la chos gsan pa/ 15 mkhan chen rgyal mtshan pa las bsnyen rdzogs mdzad pa/ 16 bla ma de nyid la gtum chung sogs kyi dbang dang khrid mang du gsan pa/ 17 bka' bzhi pa ratna shrī dang*/ mkhas pa chen po dkon mchog gzhon nu la chos gsan pa/ 18 slob dpon chen po kun dga' bkra shis la bde mchog sogs kyi dbang dang lung mang du gsan pa/ 19 bla ma don grub rin chen la bka' 'gyur lung gsan pa'i tshe bstod pa mdzad cing yum chen mor gzigs pa/ 20 bka' dang bstan bcos kyi rnam bshad rtsom par mdzad pa/ 21 slob ma la skal ba dang 'tshams par chos 'khor bskor ba/ 22 ā nanda bha dra la dbang bskur zhus pa'i tshe/ bde mchog ma hā mā ya 'khor chen sogs gzigs pa/ 23 bla ma buddha nā tha la dbang bskur zhus pa'i tshe dgyes rdor dang rnam snang du gzigs pa/ 24 slob dpon puṇye siddhi la dbang bskur zhus pa'i tshe/ dus 'khor du gzigs pa/ 25 bla ma budha shri la chos gsan pa'i tshe/ mgon po phyag drug par zhal gzigs pa/ 26 mkhan bsod nams bzang po la dbang dang lung gsan pa'i tshe/ bcu gcig zhal sogs gzigs pa/ 27 slob dpon chen po dzñan shrī la dbang bskur gsan pa'i tshe/ bde mchog gzigs pa/ 28 rdo rje 'dzin pa bkra shis rgyal mtshan la chos gsan pa'i tshe/ rgyal ba rgya mtsho lha lnga gzigs pa/ 29 rdzogs chen bsgom pa'i tshe rdo rje lu gu rgyud kyi nang du rgyal ba zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor gzigs pa/ 30 dharma dhwa dza la dbang bskur zhus pa'i tshe bde mchog lhan skyes gzigs pa/ 31 ā nanda ma ti la chos gsan pa'i tshe/ yi dam dang chos skyong gzigs pa/ 32 chos rje de bzhin gshegs pa'i drung du dbang khrid gsan pa'i tshe yi dam chos skyong du ma'i zhal gzigs pa/ 33 dus phyis rtogs ldan pa la chos gsan pa'i tshe padma rgyal po zhal gzigs pa/ 34 gnad kyi gdams pa nyams su bzhes pas sgrib pa zad 'od gsal gdod ma'i rgyal ba mngon du mdzad pa/

35 thang sku po ti rdo dril gtad de rdo rje slob dpon du dbang bskur zhing lung bstan pa/ 36 tshig nyung la don rgya che ba'i chos gsungs pa'i tshe/ bla ma rdo rje 'chang du gzigs pa/ 37 chos rje de bzhin gshegs pa gshegs nas gsol ba btabs pas mdun du byon nas ngo sprod gsungs pa/ 38 sog tu chos rje'i sku 'bag rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor du gzigs te bstod pa mdzad pa/ 39 der mtshan mo dang po'i thun la chos rje'i phyag gis cod pan 'ching ba gzigs pa/ 40 karmar slob dpon seng ge bzang po dang*/ blo ldan shes rab gzigs te brgyud pa'i bstod pa mdzad pa/ 41 der 'jam dbyangs kyis tshad ma'i bka' gnad dkrol te bstod pa mdzad pa/ 42 rnam thos kyi ri bor tshe dpag med brgyud pa'i bla mas bskor ba gzigs nas gsol ba btab pa/ 43 nyams snang la rang byung ba'i bka' gnang thob nas gsung sgros rnams la rgyas 'grel mdzad pa/ 44 skal par ldan pa'i slob ma rnams la dbang bskur zhing rgyud bstan pa/ 45 gdul bya'i dbang po dang 'tshams par chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba/ 46 tho rangs kyi tshe mi g.yo ba gzigs nas bstod pa mdzad pa/ 47 rgya mtsho sgang du rdor dbyings mdzad pa'i tshe sgrol ma dang mi 'khrugs pa sogs gzigs pa/ 48 tsā ri trar gsang bdag sogs gzigs nas slob ma la bstan pa/ 49 stag khrom du gtor ma phul ba'i tshe sprin gseb tu mgon po gzigs pa/ 50 rnam thos kyi ri bor chos skyong gi thang sku la rab gnas mdzad pas phyag nas bzung ba/ 51 nags phur dgun gyi tshe phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas gzigs pa/ 52 bsnyun pa'i tshe sprin gyi nang nas brkyang pa'i lag pas bdud rtsi thod pa gang spyi bor blugs pa/ 53 rmang lam du bde ba can gyi zhing sbyong mdzad pas gsal bar gzigs pa/ 54 mi pham rgyal ba'i gnas dga' ldan gyi zhing sbyong mdzad pa/ 55 shambha la'i bkod pa gzigs shing rigs ldan la chos gsan pa/ 56 lcang lo can gyi bkod pa gsal bar gzigs pa/

57 gzhon nu ma bzhis 'do lis bteg nas o rgyan du byon te kam pa la la gdams pa thob pa/ 58 sog tu 'phags pa byams pas chos ston pa gzigs nas pha rol tu phyin pa'i rnam 'grel mdzad pa/ 59 der rmang lam du mtsho skyes rdo rjes byin gyis brlabs shing gnang ba thob nas kyai rdor gyi rnam 'grel mdzad pa/ 60 karma pa'i rnal 'byor bsgoms pa'i tshe sku'i bkod pa du ma gzigs nas bsngags pa brjod pa/ 61 mnyel ba'i tshe mja' 'od rtse mo lnga pa gzim khang la zug pa dang*/ sa g.yo ba la sogs pa cho 'phrul bstan pa/ 62 slob dpon padma 'byung gnas mkha' 'gro ma gnyis kyis stan 'degs pa gzigs pa/ 63 'od gsal chos kyi dbyings su sprul ba'i sku'i snang ba bsdu ba'i bkod pa bstan pa/ 64 sku gdung sbyangs nas ring bsrel dang lha'i sku mang po sprul ba/ 65 smon lam gyi mthus bde ba can du gshegs pa/ 66 byang phyogs kyi rgyud du rdo rje theg pa grub pa'i rnal 'byor pas 'gro ba 'dren pa/ 67 ko sa lar rig gnas rnams la mkhas pa'i mchog tu gyur pa/ 68 khri brtan du sa skyong gi tshul gyis sems kyi don mdzad pa/ 69 ma kha'i yul gyi log par lta ba rnams yang dag pa'i lam la 'god pa/ 70 kārti ka na gdul bya lhag ma'i don du rnal 'byor pa gcig tu gyur pa/ 71 gangs ri'i rgyud du 'ong zhing chos bstan pas sems can du ma smin par mdzad pa'o/ 72 /bla ma rin po che ratna bha dra'i rnam par thar pa karma pas bsdus pa'o//
